[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip 'GOEXPERIMENT=simd needs amd64 or arm64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^f32 130 '
cp stdout $WORK/scalar-stdout.txt

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/scalar-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep 'SliceMasked' out/main.go
! grep 'archsimd' out/main.go
! grep '_logos_simd' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/scalar-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

env GOEXPERIMENT=
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/scalar-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

cp out/main.go $WORK/eject-simd-main.go
rm out
logos eject -o out
cmp out/main.go $WORK/eject-simd-main.go

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectsimdslice

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
)

func sumF32(xs []float32) float32 {
	return xs.sum()
}

func sumF64(xs []float64) float64 {
	return xs.sum()
}

func sumI32(xs []int32) int32 {
	return xs.sum()
}

func sumI64(xs []int64) int64 {
	return xs.sum()
}

func sumU8(xs []uint8) uint8 {
	return xs.sum()
}

func sumI16(xs []int16) int16 {
	return xs.sum()
}

func mix(i int) int {
	return (i*2654435761 + 12345) >> 3
}

func main() {
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 5, 8, 9, 31, 64, 67, 130} {
		f32 := make([]float32, n)
		f64 := make([]float64, n)
		c32 := make([]float32, n)
		c64 := make([]float64, n)
		i32 := make([]int32, n)
		i64 := make([]int64, n)
		u8 := make([]uint8, n)
		i16 := make([]int16, n)
		for i := range n {
			f32[i] = float32(math.Ldexp(float64(mix(i)%2001-1000), (i*7)%13-6))
			f64[i] = math.Ldexp(float64(mix(i)%2001-1000), (i*7)%13-6)
			c32[i], c64[i] = 1, 1
			if i%4 == 0 {
				c32[i], c64[i] = 1e8, 1e16
			}
			if i%4 == 2 {
				c32[i], c64[i] = -1e8, -1e16
			}
			i32[i] = int32(mix(i))
			i64[i] = int64(mix(i)) * 1000003
			u8[i] = uint8(mix(i))
			i16[i] = int16(mix(i))
		}
		fmt.Println("f32", n, math.Float32bits(sumF32(f32)))
		fmt.Println("f64", n, math.Float64bits(sumF64(f64)))
		fmt.Println("c32", n, math.Float32bits(sumF32(c32)))
		fmt.Println("c64", n, math.Float64bits(sumF64(c64)))
		fmt.Println("i32", n, sumI32(i32))
		fmt.Println("i64", n, sumI64(i64))
		fmt.Println("u8", n, sumU8(u8))
		fmt.Println("i16", n, sumI16(i16))
	}
}
